content:
To print text and variables in Python, you can use the print() function. Here are some examples:

```python
# Printing text
print("Hello, World!")

# Printing variables
x = 10
print("The value of x is:", x)

# Combining text and variables
name = "Alice"
age = 30
print("My name is", name, "and I am", age, "years old.")
```

Output:
```
Hello, World!
The value of x is: 10
My name is Alice and I am 30 years old.
```
